title: fix(runtime): mount every /api/v1/keys verb so an anonymous caller is answered 401 on the standalone server
body:
Fixes #23909

Clause-②: no

Basis for the Clause-② line: no request that was accepted becomes refused, and none that was refused becomes accepted. An anonymous non-POST call to `/api/v1/keys` was refused `405` and is now refused `401`. A signed-in one was refused `405` and still is, now in the dispatcher's standard envelope instead of the adapter's. The `401` is already published text: changeset `23225-domain-floor-anonymous-deny` (in `.changeset/pre/` for v18) says "`/keys`: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` for every verb. A verb other than `POST` used to be answered `405` to an anonymous caller; a signed-in caller still gets the 405."

## The route ledger (seat ruling `6222005517`)

The four new mounts are ledgered as four exact `server-only` rows, `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE /keys`. Their note says they are refusal-only: the anonymous floor answers 401, and a signed-in caller gets the domain's 405. The census count moves 88 → 92. There is no wildcard row: no `/keys` sub-path is mounted. `route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts` is 8/8 locally at `5e3b39fcd`. It was 7/8 at `41fc6bb39`, where "every mounted route is ledgered" failed on these four mounts; the dogfood shards do not run on a PR. The claim's original "no new row" line was wrong, because #7649's `/mcp/skill` was covered by the `* /mcp/**` wildcard; the correction is `6222005517` on the card.

## What changed

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` are mounted on `${prefix}/keys` beside the unchanged `POST`, each dispatching its own method to `/keys`, in the shape of the `/mcp` and `/mcp/skill` helpers above it. The comment says why (the domain's floor answers only a verb that reaches it, precedent #7649) and that the `PUT` and `PATCH` mounts are not wrapped by the per-route instrumentation, like the other `PUT`/`PATCH` mounts in the file.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.routes.test.ts`: the `/keys` expectation goes from `POST` alone to the five verbs.
- `packages/runtime/src/keys-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts` (new pin): a real Hono socket. For each anonymous non-POST verb it asserts `status` 401, `error.code` `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `error.httpStatus` 401 and no `error.details`. For each signed-in non-POST verb it asserts 405, `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `error.httpStatus` 405 and no `error.details`. That last pair tells the domain's answer from the adapter's, which fills `details` and no `httpStatus`. Anonymous `POST` is the unchanged control.
- `.changeset/23909-keys-every-verb-anonymous-floor.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` `patch`.

Not touched, as ruled: `domains/keys.ts`, the observability Proxy's verb list, `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`, the `/notifications` and `/share-links` mounts, and `docs/qa/`. `route-ledger.ts` gains the four rows above, by the seat's corrected ruling.

## Measured on a live boot

Stock showcase, `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT`, built from base `f901746ac` and from head `41fc6bb39`; signed in as the seeded admin.

| call | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| anonymous `GET` / `PUT` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` `/api/v1/keys` | `405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `Allow: POST`, adapter body `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED","message":"GET is not supported for /api/v1/keys. Allowed: POST.","details":{...}}}` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Authentication is required to access this endpoint.","httpStatus":401}}` |
| signed-in `GET` / `PUT` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` `/api/v1/keys` | `405`, `Allow: POST`, adapter body | `405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED","message":"Method not allowed","httpStatus":405}}`, no `Allow` header |
| anonymous `POST /api/v1/keys` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` (unchanged) |
| anonymous `HEAD /api/v1/keys` | `405`, `Allow: POST` | `401` |
| `GET /api/v1/keys/anything` (either caller) | `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` (unchanged) |

The cloud-host shape (`@objectstack/hono`'s `createHonoApp` catch-all, driven in process with `app.request` over a `LiteKernel` and a fake `auth` service, base build) already answered every anonymous verb `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` and every signed-in non-POST verb the domain's `405` with no `Allow`. This PR makes the standalone server answer the same.

## Tests

- Pin + route list, head `41fc6bb39`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/keys-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts src/dispatcher-plugin.routes.test.ts` → `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 25 passed (25)`.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the four `mountKeys(...)` calls (anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1, blob `05f460424d3c` → `89de55c9ef5d`). The same run gave `Tests 9 failed | 16 passed (25)`: the 4 anonymous rows failed with `expected 405 to be 401`, the 4 signed-in rows with `expected undefined to be 405` (the adapter's body has no `httpStatus`), and the route-list case failed. Anonymous `POST` stayed green. Restore: blob == HEAD `05f460424d3c`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./dispatcher-plugin.js` from source, so no `dist/` sits on its resolution path.
- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/runtime...' --concurrency=2` → exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` → exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` → exit 0, `Test Files 404 passed (404)`, `Tests 6139 passed | 19 skipped (6158)`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed `.ts` files → exit 0.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands for this diff. All 62 exit 0 at head `41fc6bb39`, and `--ran` reconciles: `62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Also run, all exit 0: the five roster families whose roster sits under a changed directory (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:route-ledger-census`). The repo-wide lint is the PR's `Lint & Repo Gates` check-run.

## Acceptance notes (seen on the way, not changed here)

- **The domain's 405 carries no `Allow` header.** A signed-in non-POST call used to get the adapter's `405` with `Allow: POST`. Now it gets the `keys` domain's `405`, built through `deps.error` with no header. The cloud host already answered this way. `domains/mcp.ts`, `domains/meta.ts` and `domains/ai.ts` hand-roll `Allow` on their 405s; `domains/keys.ts` and `domains/actions.ts` do not.
- **`PUT` and `PATCH` mounts are not instrumented.** On the live head, `GET` and `DELETE /api/v1/keys` echo `X-Request-Id` and `PUT` and `PATCH` do not. The observability Proxy wraps only `get`, `post` and `delete`. The other mounts it misses are `PATCH` on `/packages/:id`, `/packages/:id/enable` and `/packages/:id/disable`, `PUT /automation/:name`, the `PUT` and `PATCH` `/ai/*` wildcards, and service-emitted `PATCH` routes through `mountRouteOnServer`.
- **The same mount gap on sibling doors** of the v18 anonymous-floor text, on the standalone server (base and head alike):
  - anonymous `DELETE` / `PUT /api/v1/notifications` → `405`, `Allow: GET, HEAD`;
  - anonymous `PUT` / `DELETE /api/v1/share-links` → `405`, `Allow: GET, HEAD, POST`;
  - an unserved `/api/v1/share-links` sub-path → `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.

  The cloud-host probe answered `401` for anonymous `DELETE /api/v1/notifications` and for an unserved `/api/v1/share-links` sub-path (the other verbs above were not probed there). On the standalone server, `/api/v1/share-links` is served by `plugin-sharing`'s own routes, not the dispatcher domain, so its anonymous `401` carries that plugin's message and no `httpStatus`.
